authority.governing_instruction: physicalities are entities themselves; entity unique object; physicality shape/form/usage/observation
authority.implementation_gap: The existing persistence record has a storage fingerprint and target entity reference, but no canonical entity representation of the physicality object itself.

identity.owner: ordinary native Unicode and ordered-composition identity
identity.physicality_record_identity: existing native 256-bit immutable record fingerprint; storage and integrity address
identity.physicality_entity_identity: ordinary canonical identity of the exact structured descriptor, never truncation of the record fingerprint
identity.roles: typed trajectory and recipe metadata; no replacement of canonical child identities
identity.mutable_observation_context: retained as occurrence or attestation; does not enter the immutable descriptor identity

descriptor.reference_values: existing canonical entity references, not names, JSON or printed hash values
descriptor.unsigned_scalar_values: canonical base-ten Unicode numeral composition through the shared native builder
descriptor.binary64_values: exact unsigned 64-bit payload words; preserve signed zero and every admitted bit pattern without host-locale conversion
descriptor.record_digest_values: exact ordered octet values represented through the same scalar composition owner
descriptor.validation: Recompute the native physicality identity, actual carrier fingerprint, decoded occurrence law and exact count before constructing or accepting the descriptor. Unsupported record forms and invalid scalar encodings reject explicitly.
descriptor.resource_admission: Independent maximum requests, operands, physical carriers and expanded logical identity count; reject before hashing an over-budget run sequence. The native owner supplies checked conservative peak plan/validation memory bounds covering maps, vector spare capacity and scratch, excluding borrowed original bytes.
descriptor.source_identity_validation: The same native validator returns the full reconstructed composition witness and actual trajectory tier when available. Atomic geometry and non-atom singleton records cannot certify canonical content witnesses or tiers by themselves; the bridge must use an independently verified content owner.

finite_view.authority: verified original immutable physicality record and canonical descriptor recipe
finite_view.index: record-to-descriptor root and every generated internal entity needed for ordinary indexed entity and trajectory resolution
finite_view.readback: ordinary native provider callbacks and shared materialization kernel
finite_view.publication: canonical identities and indexed derivation ownership are admitted transactionally; generated view physicalities are calculated under the pinned read context
finite_view.termination: Construct only the finite descriptor requested by the operation. Generating a view does not recursively enqueue persistence or reflection of its own generated physicalities.
finite_view.cache: rebuildable derived acceleration, never independent authority
finite_view.root_scope: The native materializer begins each root with its exact source receipt and recipe; a verified view binds selected external representations and native scope receipt. Changing roots cannot reuse a conflicting physical selection or cached node.
finite_view.read_context: Retained full admission context, selected source, native input fingerprint and all four work caps remain bound into the view ID. Cold reads may use a different current resource grant and read-only effect restriction; all semantic epochs and authority remain pinned. The explicit original-source overload requires both the retained owner receipt and exact original root P; generated reads use generated intervals, original reads use historical intervals. The same parent body may legitimately have different selected-child receipts in those two contexts, which remain separate.
finite_view.candidate_reconstruction: Thirteen set-wise frontier query executions, independent of selected owner count, plus actual nested Unicode perfcache queries and explicit plan preparations. The conservative read admission ceiling is twenty-five operations: thirteen frontier executions plus two pins each admitting up to four preparations and two support SELECTs. This ceiling is not a fixed charge. One caller-owned counter is charged before every actual query or preparation; warm cache hits add no support operations, invalidation charges its actual refresh, and caught failures retain attempted work. SPI connection, kept-plan lifecycle and filesystem I/O are not reported as queries. Two indexed set-wise queries inventory and fetch each selected complete occurrence binding set once. Native validation and plan memory are pre-admitted; the provider separately bounds logical identity work at one step per granted byte, a physical policy rather than a byte-cost identity. One additional bounded atom-body set authenticates pinned canonical placement; no per-descriptor SQL fallback is used.
finite_view.occurrence_selection: Different physicalities of one canonical entity remain distinct per parent physicality and exact logical occurrence interval. RLE storage cannot erase those selected forms, and an entity-only selector map does not establish complete occurrence semantics.
finite_view.entity_reference_geometry: Every descriptor entity-valued field uses the shared native canonical-content reference recipe under the pinned geometry epoch, reconstructed from authenticated ordered content and actual canonical atom bodies. Historical source physicalities and full witnesses remain separate immutable evidence. Several physicalities of one E never select geometry by minimum, first match, or unrelated batch context.
finite_view.reference_nodes: Ordinary native reference results are indexed after descriptor results within the same finite view and reconstructed cold. Generated historical-free edge selections derive from each program's actual known/prior-result operands; owner recipe is authenticated independently of each generated node recipe. No generated physicality or observation is deposited.
finite_view.source_retention: Each view retains its exact original root tuple. Complete reachable historical scopes retain their authenticated selected-source frontier and reference immutable per-parent interval receipts; unrelated admitted parents cannot change a view or its canonical descriptor.
finite_view.source_and_view_epochs: An immutable source physicality and pinned Unicode input retain their own authenticated geometry epochs. A new descriptor, reference, or parent composition may use a different view epoch while consuming those exact inputs. Native body identity, full content witness, centroid and selected occurrence bindings remain mandatory. Readback may cross the view epoch only for an exact entity/physicality pair authenticated by the retained owner; unbound discovery and ordinary caller-only selections remain constrained to the current geometry.

acceptance: original realized entity identities remain unchanged
different legitimate physicalities of one target have distinct exact descriptor identities
the same physicality observed again reuses its descriptor and ordinary constituent entities
a descriptor and its internal nodes are usable as ordinary entity and trajectory operands
normal cold-provider readback reconstructs the complete descriptor with the same identity as warm readback
a changed immutable field, carrier, selector or owner mapping is rejected
signed-zero bit distinctions survive wherever the original schema admits them
finite work and output envelopes reject exhaustion rather than truncate topology
replay and caller rollback preserve exact canonical and observation counts
no eager unbounded reflection chain is emitted
